quizName:
Hardest Questions in Washington
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What can impair a person's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires good physical condition. Alcohol, medications, and being tired can all impair your driving.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of upcoming hazards. This sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?

options.text: It makes you feel overly confident.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reactions, impairs your thinking, and reduces your ability to judge distance and react to danger.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of upcoming hazards. This sign warns you of a steep downhill ahead. Reduce your speed to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: Who must wear a seat belt while in a moving vehicle?
questions.explanation: By law, all people in a moving vehicle must wear a properly fastened seat belt. Police can stop and ticket drivers or passengers who are not wearing one. Drivers are fined if passengers under 16 are not wearing a seat belt.

questions.question: If you are in a serious crash, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle off the road if possible. Call 911 if anyone is hurt and provide help. You must report the crash to police if someone is injured, someone dies, or property damage exceeds $1,000.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: When borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend, you should:

options.text: Not worry because all vehicles work the same.
Hide that you are unfamiliar with it.
Ignore any obvious problems to avoid upsetting your friend.
Spend a few minutes learning where and how to use the vehicle's controls and equipment.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spend a few minutes learning where and how to use the vehicle's controls and equipment.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, learn the location and operation of the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, wipers, washers, brakes, gear selector, and horn. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right of way. Left-turning drivers must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: If you operate a motor vehicle registered in Washington State, you must:

options.text: Have liability insurance and carry an ID card proving you have it.
Carry insurance only if you ride a motorcycle or drive a large truck.
Carry insurance only if you are under age 18.
Carry insurance only if your car is less than five years old.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have liability insurance and carry an ID card proving you have it.
questions.explanation: All motor vehicles registered in Washington State must have liability insurance. You must carry proof of this insurance with you.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even small amounts of alcohol harm your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn drivers about railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: On a freeway, you realize you missed your turn or exit. You should:

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your current lane.
Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: Never back up or stop on a freeway. Continue to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and drive a different way.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. You must obey it. Passing is prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate is lowered.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Not worry about how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means left turns are not allowed. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Use your turn signal three to four seconds before you turn. This tells other drivers what you plan to do.

questions.question: You should slow down in which situations?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, where pedestrians are present, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, what must you do?

options.text: Always signal, even if no other traffic is visible.
Signal only if other traffic is visible.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only when driving in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other traffic is visible.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from a curb. Make this a habit, not something you do only sometimes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers make about 200 decisions for every mile driven. You must focus completely on driving. Any other task takes your attention away and creates danger.
